The '''Imperial citadel''' was a secret [[Galactic Empire]] fortress on the<ref name="Topps" /> [[Deep Core]]<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> [[planet]] [[Byss]], the secret [[throneworld]] of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. [[Mas Amedda]],<ref name="Topps" /> who served as [[Grand Vizier]] of the Empire,<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> retreated to the citadel, where he outlined plans for the [[New Order]]<ref name="Topps" /> Imperial [[Politics|political]] ideology<ref name="Propaganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref> that would last for 10,000 [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="Topps" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Imperial citadel was mentioned in the "Mas Amedda" card for the "Sith Information Guide" subset of [[2015 Topps Star Wars Chrome Perspectives|2015 Topps ''Star Wars'' Chrome Perspectives: Jedi vs. Sith]], a set released by [[Topps]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Topps" /> The [[Emperor's Citadel|Imperial Citadel]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[Dark Empire 2|second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, written by [[Tom Veitch]], illustrated by [[Cam Kennedy]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on<ref name="DE2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref> [[February 18]], [[1992]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54058/star_wars_dark_empire_1991_2|text=Star Wars: Dark Empire (1991) #2}}</ref>
